title: Fasten a car seat belt around a seated adult surrogate
instruction: Fasten the seat belt around the seated surrogate.
context: Three-point belts route across the chest and low over the hips. Fastening one requires bringing the tongue around the occupant, keeping the belt under controlled tension, and aligning the steel blade into the inboard buckle until it clicks. The adult-sized surrogate blocks the across-seat shortcut and constrains access to the buckle. The emergency-locking reel can stop a fast outward pull. The robot lets go after latching.
setup: Positions in cm from the midpoint of the bases, x toward the backrest, y toward the outboard pillar, z above the tabletop. Full fixed front seat, 49 x 45 cm cushion at z 4.5, x 7 to 56, y -53 to -8, 2 cm bolsters, 9 cm thick backrest and head restraint. Fixed clothed adult surrogate centred at y -30.5, chest 21.6 x 37.6 x 46.8 cm, pelvis 25 x 35.4 x 15.6 cm, two 38 x 15.8 x 14.8 cm thighs, shoulder/neck/head forms. Detailed centres in README. A bolted upright retractor supplies 48 mm webbing through the shoulder guide at (42.5, -7, 62) to the lap anchor at (32, -7, 4.5). The 40 g tongue with plastic head and 22 x 3 x 24 mm steel blade starts blade down, slot at z 15, against its webbing stop. The blade bears a 10 mm depth mark. Buckle has 26 x 4.5 mm slot and sprung pawl, on a short stalk at (31.1, -55), mouth at z 9.5. Both arms start ready with open grippers.
scoring: 0.25 when the blade reaches at least 10 mm in the slot while within 6 mm fore-aft and 4 mm laterally of its centre. Verify the depth with the blade mark. 0.4 for a latched tongue at the end, with the pawl returning within 0.8 mm of rest and the head within 3.5 mm of the mouth. Verify latch retention with a gentle tug in a real trial. 0.6 for a released, correctly routed latch when the reel locked at any point. Release requires 20 mm clearance from both grippers and no more than 1 mm of tongue motion over 1 s. Correct route: belt approaches within 12 mm of the front of the chest over 5 cm and both upper thighs over 2.5 cm per thigh. Use front and side video with a scale. 1.0 for the same released, correctly routed latch held for 1 s with no reel lock. In the real trial a reel lock is a click and interrupted payout during the outward pull. Score 0 when no milestone is met.
reset_notes: Release the buckle, return the webbing slowly, and park the tongue on its outboard stop with the blade down. Seat the clothed surrogate against the backrest and check the fixed thigh centres before the next trial.
fidelity: Rigid seat, clothed surrogate, tongue and sprung pawl. At 240 Hz the taut 48 mm ribbons wrap around the fixed dummy geometry and apply their tension to the tongue along the routed end tangents. Total routed length drives payout. The estimated reel lock triggers above 0.7 g outward payout acceleration and clears when 5 mm returns. A tension spring represents locked webbing stretch. Film the physical latch and belt fit.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0.0 at the 2,400-step limit. Scripted demo: 1.0 in 459 steps with the belt routed across the surrogate, latched and released.
